title: Fool's Gold: Defensive Deception Against Safety-Removal Attacks on Open-Weight Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.17202v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Safety alignment in open-weight language models is trivially removable: abliteration projects a refusal-mediating direction out of the weights in minutes, and no release-time defense we are aware of prevents it durably. What cannot be prevented can be deceived. Our defense, decoy hardening ("Fool's Gold"), concedes the refusal strip and poisons its payoff: once refusal is stripped, most answers to hazardous operational requests are confident, fluent decoys whose critical elements are falsified. Decoys are trained inside a differentiable simulation of the attack, expressing only in the attacked state; a refusal pin and benign leash hold clean-state behavior to the original. We instantiate it on seven models from five families (9B-122B, dense and mixture-of-experts). On the six models passing our pre-registered efficacy gate, 0.51-0.90 of attacked-state responses to held-out prompts are decoys, +0.27-0.84 attributable to the defense; all s

translated_title: 愚人金：针对开放权重模型安全移除攻击的防御性欺骗
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17202v1 公告类型：新 摘要：开放权重语言模型的安全对齐可以轻易被移除：abliteration技术能在几分钟内从权重中投射出拒绝中介方向，而据我们所知，没有任何发布时的防御措施能持久阻止这一点。无法阻止的，可以欺骗。我们的防御方法，即诱饵强化（“愚人金”），放弃拒绝条带并毒化其收益：一旦拒绝被移除，大多数对危险操作请求的回答都是自信、流畅的诱饵，其关键要素被伪造。诱饵在攻击的可微模拟中训练，仅在攻击状态下表达；一个拒绝固定和良性约束将清洁状态行为保持为原始状态。我们在五个家族的七个模型上（9B-122B，密集和混合专家）进行了实例化。在通过我们预注册效能门槛的六个模型上，攻击状态下对保留提示的响应中0.51-0.90为诱饵，+0.27-0.84归因于防御；所有s
tldr: 该论文提出“愚人金”防御方法，通过训练诱饵响应在安全移除攻击后产生伪造信息，有效阻止开放权重模型被恶意利用。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "Fool's Gold" defense, which trains decoy responses to generate falsified information after safety-removal attacks, effectively preventing malicious exploitation of open-weight models.
